show.description:
Trapped in a toxic marriage and betrayed by those closest to her, a woman finally breaks free.
With her brothers’ support, she rises from humiliation to fight betrayal, scandal, and revenge.
A tale of courage, dignity, and a daring new beginning—New Life is about reclaiming what’s lost.
